verdicts.item:
3. A04-2, A04-4: Submitting an admitted implementation activates it, the Activation recorded by
   the kernel; submitting it again changes nothing.
   [witness: verification:kernel_a04_admitted_submission_activates_once]
statements: A04-2: admitted <-> corpus != empty AND for_all case IN corpus: passed(case)

A04-4: submit(impl) AND verdict(impl, current_corpus) = admitted
         AND current_activation != impl  -> new Activation(by kernel)
verdicts.why: The check asserts A04-4: an admitted submission activates the implementation by the kernel when it is not current, while immediate resubmission reuses the same activation and verdict; it also controls that resubmission after another implementation becomes current creates a new activation. It only tests the positive side of A04-2 with a nonempty one-case corpus that passes and is admitted, so it does not establish the full biconditional for empty corpora or failing cases.
